fusions.name: Gnawed Through
fusions.desc: Strikes a target at or below 25% health, consuming every affliction on it and adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to this blow that deals 16 damage.

fusions.name: Skirting Dust
fusions.desc: Kicks up a cone of dust 3 tiles long, dealing 3 damage to everything in it, with a 30% chance to leave each [Blunted] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Behind the Wainscot
fusions.desc: Veils you for 8 seconds and speeds you up by 15% while it holds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Rung by Rung
fusions.desc: After you cover a stretch of ground, your critical hit chance rises by 15% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
